parsed.note: The proposal only tunes training hyperparameters (LR 0.06→0.05, depth/aspect/batch/warmup experiments) and leaves the fixed evaluation block (EVAL_SHARD 10, EVAL_SPLIT, EVAL_TOKENS) and TRAIN_SHARDS '0-9' untouched, so val_bpb still measures genuine held-out quality.
